name: Founder selfie with punch cards
suits: before and after: what we did, what changed
a founder's result story with a service or product inside
we tried X, it did not work, then Y did

spine.note: Selfie, straight to camera, the setup in the first breath ('We hired a social media manager before'). Small words run; the one phrase that matters lands big on a brand-colour plate under them, the tail word small beneath it. The captions do this by themselves (the tiered lane): mark the phrase with *stars* in the lines.

Hard cut to a plain white card; the voice carries on. The old way in a few big brand-colour words, stacked and repeated ('MORE POSTS / MORE POSTS / MORE POSTS'), then the next words blur in and out on a slant ('WE GOT BETTER DESIGNS'). Type only, no picture. Cast type-punch-card (lines with repeat, x/y spots, an italic word, from-directions).

Back to the person for the turn ('but nothing actually DROVE PIPELINE ... then we hired ...'). The plate lands on the result word; when the line names the company, its logo pops in as a small pill sticker in place of the plate for a second. The logo pill is sticker-prop kind 'logo' (text: the company name; the brand kit's wordmark fills in), timed to the name, hold about 1.2s.

Full-frame product surface shot close and at an angle with a shallow focus (the dashboard the line describes), slowly drifting; captions keep running over it and a named tool lands as its own logo word ('connected to HubSpot').

The longest beat: what was built, point by point. Plate on the headline phrase with a small contrast line under it ('GENERATING LEADS / not likes'); one phrase goes huge in plain white with no plate ('ACTUAL PIPELINE'). The camera punches in for the middle of the beat and back out.

Hard cut to white: a small lead line, then three short items stacking one per spoken word ('our hooks / our formats / our CTAs'); the stacked list rides over the person as the next beat cuts back. Cast stack-list (lead + items timed to their words); cast it again on the next scene with ground 'none' and settled true so it rides over the person.

The result in four words, big and plain ('SAME TEAM') with the small payoff under it ('completely different output'); the logo pill once more on the company's name; the ask said to camera ('link below to book a call'). The logo pill is sticker-prop kind 'logo' (text: the company name; the brand kit's wordmark fills in), timed to the name, hold about 1.2s.

The brand's dark colour, the wordmark drawing in, the ask ('Book a call') below it with a hand-drawn box sketching round it. The voice has stopped; the music carries it out. Name the scene 'End_card - <the ask>' (e.g. 'End_card - Book a call'): the build casts the logo close with that ask boxed by hand.

captions.note: two sizes: running words small and white, two or three at a time; the line's key phrase big on a brand-colour plate (slightly tilted), or big plain white for the payoff, with its tail line small beneath

stamps.note: the company logo as a small pill sticker, popped in on its name, in place of the caption for a second

music.feel: bright, light, steady pulse under the voice; carries the end card alone
